name: zmodel_set_di_texture_world_per_meter
description: zModel::SetDiTextureWorldPerMeter sets DI texture-world metadata, toggling flag bit 5 from the world-space enable argument and storing the per-meter scale and axis.
known_limits: tier S verification was not attempted in this session. Functional coverage checks null handling, flag-bit updates, and stored texture-world fields.
functional_evidence: Binary Ninja reconstruction and assembly for 0x4760d0 validate null-di error reporting and return 1, flag bit 5 set from worldSpaceEnabled & 1 while preserving other bits, textureWorldPerMeter stored at offset 0x24, textureWorldAxis stored at offset 0x28, and success return 0.
The native zModel smoke verifies null return, clearing and setting flag bit 5, preservation of other flag bits, and storage of textureWorldPerMeter and textureWorldAxis.
